ns2:section.sectionText: This section is reserved for non-UIUC students and does not count toward an engineering graduate degree (UIUC undergraduate students interested in this course may enroll in ENG 451 SW1). Academic Outreach assessments of $889 per credit hour apply. This course is restricted to students who have a career-related internship or co-op during the Summer 2010 term. If you do not meet this requirement you will be disqualified from the course. Please contact Sarah Zehr at szehr@illinois.edu or 217-333-1960 with questions about this policy.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC or NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC.
